role: Sprint 4.6 — roster expansion (arity 4) + two sealed experiments: A (rigidity middle-rank retest), B (relation-level terrain prediction). Committed BEFORE any terrain of the expanded roster is measured or fit. (Referred to as 'prereg_v9' in the owner brief; this is the next version in sequence.)
supersedes: extends v9 (connectivity) + v10 (rigidity). No oracle column touched.

roster_expansion.construction: arity-3 (full enumeration, 4-7 tuples) + arity-4 (bounded random sample, 5-13 tuples, seeded), grouped by IDENTICAL 6-flag polymorphism profile. Feasibility probe (algebra only, no terrain): 23 distinct profiles.

resolution_targets.A_middle_ranks: >= 5 genuine same-profile representatives in EACH of rank 2 (semilattice) and rank 3 (majority) — the ranks where the 3~2 tie sits. FEASIBLE per probe (ranks 2,3 have profiles with 5-215 reps).
resolution_targets.rank_4_maltsev: reported SEPARATELY. Affine relations are structurally RARE (probe: max 3 reps per affine profile) — a declared cap, NOT a resolution failure. Rank 4's envelope-pinning is already firm (Sprint 4.5: spread 0.039); it is re-reported at whatever reps exist, not required to reach 5.
resolution_targets.rank_1_weak_NU_only: EMPTY by Post's lattice — no Boolean idempotent clone is weak-NU-only without min/max/majority/minority. A declared mathematical absence, not a resolution failure.
resolution_targets.B_held_out: >= 6 co-clones with >= 5 representatives each, so a held-out-by-co-clone split is well-posed.

roster_expansion.resolution_floor: if A cannot reach >=5 reps in BOTH rank 2 and rank 3, A returns INSUFFICIENT_RESOLUTION (roster size). If B cannot reach >=6 co-clones x >=5 reps, B returns INSUFFICIENT_RESOLUTION. Declared here, before results exist.

experiment_A_rigidity_middle_rank_retest.sealed_prediction: the SAME as prereg_v10: within-co-clone ruggedness spread DECREASES MONOTONICALLY with rigidity rank. Scored on the fuller sample; rank 4's envelope-pinning reported separately (already firm).
experiment_A_rigidity_middle_rank_retest.the_3_2_tie: Sprint 4.5's rank 3 (0.140) ~ rank 2 (0.138) is currently ambiguous between thin-strata noise and a real absence of ordering in the hierarchy's middle. The expanded roster (>=5 reps each) discriminates.
experiment_A_rigidity_middle_rank_retest.zero_one_valid_exclusion_PRE_REGISTERED: 0-valid and 1-valid are TRIVIAL-SATISFIABILITY properties (closure under a constant; all-0/all-1 always satisfies) — they RIDE the lattice, they are NOT idempotent Taylor conditions. Therefore the rank assignment ignores 0/1-validity (rank = strongest idempotent term: Maltsev/majority/semilattice), and co-clones distinguished ONLY by 0/1-validity (the pure {0v},{1v},{0v,1v} strata) are EXCLUDED from A. This principle is stated HERE, before the run; the exclusion is scored as pre-registered. (In prereg_v10 the -0.629 excl-edge was post-hoc and stands only as exploratory, reported beside the full-set number.)

verdict_vocab.CONFIRMED: spread strictly decreasing rank 3 > rank 2 with the fuller sample (tie resolved in favor of ordering) + negative rank<->spread correlation
verdict_vocab.TIE_REAL: rank 3 ~ rank 2 persists with adequate resolution (>=5 reps each) -> the middle of the hierarchy genuinely does not order terrain

experiment_B_relation_level_terrain_pred.question: do features of the SPECIFIC relation (the information the clone discards) predict terrain where clone-level invariants provably cannot?
experiment_B_relation_level_terrain_pred.feature_set_is_CLOSED: EXACTLY THREE features, mechanisms + signs written here before any fit. No fourth feature; if none of the three predicts, that IS the result.

i_density.mechanism: sparse relations force tight variable coupling (few allowed tuples -> solutions pinned together far apart -> rugged); dense relations leave slack (smoother). Headline feature.

ii_arity.definition: the relation's arity (2-4 across the expanded roster)
ii_arity.mechanism: unclear a priori: higher arity spreads each constraint over more variables (could dilute per-variable coupling -> smoother) OR couples more variables jointly (-> rugged). Tested for a monotone effect; no committed sign, so it does NOT satisfy the sign-match clause of the decision rule.

iii_tuple_dispersion.definition: mean pairwise Hamming distance among R's tuples, normalized by arity
iii_tuple_dispersion.mechanism: a relation whose allowed tuples sit far apart in Hamming space propagates that spread to its instances' solution sets -> rugged. Relation-intrinsic geometry the clone discards.

evaluation_both_required.permutation_null: shuffle the feature->outcome pairing, refit, build the envelope; fixed harness with a hand-count selftest in CI. The fit must beat the null envelope.
evaluation_both_required.held_out_split_by_coclone: fit on a subset of co-clones, predict the ruggedness of representatives in UNSEEN co-clones; compare to the marginal (mean-ruggedness) baseline. HELD-OUT IS PRIMARY; in-sample is sensitivity only.

sealed_decision_rule.SUPPORTED: a pre-registered SIGNED feature's sign matches (density NEGATIVE or tuple_dispersion POSITIVE) AND the fit beats the permutation envelope AND held-out beats the marginal baseline
sealed_decision_rule.NOT_SUPPORTED: the fit does not beat the null, or held-out does not beat the baseline, or the signed features' signs do not match
sealed_decision_rule.INSUFFICIENT_RESOLUTION: the B roster floor (>=6 co-clones x >=5 reps) is not met

experiment_B_relation_level_terrain_pred.framing_if_supported: complexity is a CLONE-level property; terrain would be a RELATION-level one — two components of the hardness vector living at different resolutions of the same object. Sharper than the retired basis hypothesis. Novelty language ONLY after the bridge hunt.

bridge_hunt_before_novelty: timeboxed search of the adjacent vocabularies (random-CSP instance structure; constraint density and clustering/satisfiability thresholds; relation density and solution-space geometry). The statistical-physics literature on random-CSP ensembles is the likeliest neighbor and may already own the density mechanism. Any novelty claim in B's findings is gated on this hunt (R20).
standing_discipline: prereg before any fit touches measured data
feature set CLOSED at three; no post-hoc fourth
the permutation harness hand-count selftest stays in CI
score at size; INSUFFICIENT_RESOLUTION and NOT_SUPPORTED are legal
eightfold byte-identical; no oracle cell touched
